question: Can v3 lawfully adopt the first causal RTH directional state that formed while flat but produced no turn, only after that same state is fully coherent, aligned with strictly-prior hard and soft daily context, inside the existing entry and ATR-velocity limits, and has already financed its own frozen round-trip cost?
null_hypothesis: Initial-state non-adoption is valuable. Any midcycle adoption adds chase, giveback, direction imbalance, annual instability, or drawdown despite apparently financed movement.

mechanism.population: Each RTH session's first non-null directional_impulse.trend_state while the ordinary v3 owner is flat and before any ordinary v3 turn, proposal, block, or admission.
mechanism.state_birth: Freeze direction and close at the first causal non-null trend_state; never seed or warm from GTH or premarket.
eligibility: The initial trend_state remains unchanged through the trigger.
No earlier ordinary v3 turn, proposal, blocked proposal, or admission occurred in the session.
The current ordinary v3 snapshot has no entry_dir, entry_proposed_dir, or entry_blocked_by.
turn_ready is true with at least three observed horizons.
Every observed horizon slope agrees with the state direction, expressed by coherence exactly 1.0.
Strictly-prior daily hard_direction and soft_direction both equal the state direction.
ATR velocity remains inside the existing [0.0, 0.055) admission band.
The trigger is no earlier than 09:35 ET and no later than 11:20 ET for down or 11:30 ET for up.
Direction-aligned close displacement from state birth finances the cell's exact multiple of the frozen 0.10-point research round trip.
mechanism.turn_specific_boundary: Retrace is neither required nor relaxed because the tested population has no turn; every ordinary turn continues through the unchanged v3 admission gate.
mechanism.entry: Inject one research-only admission at the qualifying completed close; the unchanged backtest engine executes at the next bar open.
mechanism.one_bar_confirmation: Arm at first eligibility, then require the next completed bar to retain the same state, remain eligible, contain no ordinary turn/proposal/admission, and close no worse in the state direction.
mechanism.session_limit: At most one cold-start adoption per RTH session; expire on an opposite state, any ordinary v3 turn/proposal/admission, the direction-specific window close, or session end.
mechanism.lifecycle: After entry, reuse exact v3 minimum ownership, maturation, financing, surrender, flip, EOD, spread, commission, and next-open semantics without modification.

acceptance.neighbor_gate: full and every annual net no worse, with no drawdown regression

fail_closed: Any baseline identity mismatch aborts before candidate results are interpreted.
Missing context, impulse, horizon, ATR velocity, causal day, or alignment blocks the candidate rather than imputing it.
The August 3 live discovery session is absent from the frozen historical challenge.
No failed cell may be rescued with another threshold, date label, direction exception, news sign, or premarket feature.
A signal pass cannot change the crown, live selection, capital plan, strategy runtime, order authority, or profitability clock.
